97: def ast_from_serialized_value_untyped(serialized: Any) -> Optional[ValueNode]:
98:     """Given a serialized value, try our best to produce an AST.
99: 
100:     Anything ressembling an array (instance of Mapping) will be converted
101:     to an ObjectFieldNode.
102: 
103:     Anything ressembling a list (instance of Iterable - except str)
104:     will be converted to a ListNode.
105: 
106:     In some cases, a custom scalar can be serialized differently in the query
107:     than in the variables. In that case, this function will not work."""
108: 
109:     if serialized is None or serialized is Undefined:
110:         return NullValueNode()
111: 
112:     if isinstance(serialized, Mapping):
113:         field_items = (
114:             (key, ast_from_serialized_value_untyped(value))
115:             for key, value in serialized.items()
116:         )
117:         field_nodes = tuple(
118:             ObjectFieldNode(name=NameNode(value=field_name), value=field_value)
119:             for field_name, field_value in field_items
120:             if field_value
121:         )
122:         return ObjectValueNode(fields=field_nodes)
123: 
124:     if isinstance(serialized, Iterable) and not isinstance(serialized, str):
125:         maybe_nodes = (ast_from_serialized_value_untyped(item) for item in serialized)
126:         nodes = tuple(node for node in maybe_nodes if node)
127:         return ListValueNode(values=nodes)
128: 
129:     if isinstance(serialized, bool):
130:         return BooleanValueNode(value=serialized)
131: 
132:     if isinstance(serialized, int):
133:         return IntValueNode(value=str(serialized))
134: 
135:     if isinstance(serialized, float) and isfinite(serialized):
136:         value = str(serialized)
137:         if value.endswith(".0"):
138:             value = value[:-2]
139:         return FloatValueNode(value=value)
140: 
141:     if isinstance(serialized, str):
142:         return StringValueNode(value=serialized)
143: 
144:     raise TypeError(f"Cannot convert value to AST: {inspect(serialized)}.")
145:
